Which statement explains why solid magnesium is a good conductor of electricity?
A
Magnesium has delocalised electrons that can move through the lattice.
B
Magnesium has strong attractions between ions.
C
Magnesium consists of a giant lattice of anions in a ‘sea’ of delocalised electrons.
D
Magnesium consists of metal ions that move through the lattice.

options.label: A
options.text: Magnesium has delocalised electrons that can move through the lattice.

options.label: B
options.text: Magnesium has strong attractions between ions.

options.label: C
options.text: Magnesium consists of a giant lattice of anions in a ‘sea’ of delocalised electrons.

options.label: D
